name: Run to Steal Animals!
desc:
🏃 Run to Steal Animals!

The floor is falling apart — run fast, grab Eggs, and hatch the rarest Animals!

How to Play:
🏃 Run and avoid falling when the floor disappears
🥚 Steal eggs from pets
🐣 Hatch your Eggs to unlock rare Animals
💰 Earn money from your Animals — even while offline
🏋️ Train on the Treadmill to increase your Speed
🏗️ Upgrade your base to unlock more Animal slots
✨ Discover rarer Eggs, Animals, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
👍 Support the game by liking and favoriting — and join the group for bonus rewards!
